title: Geriatric Registry of Wuerzburg
summary:
Geriatric registry study aiming to scientifically evaluate data collected during routine inpatient care.

Population ageing is leading to a growing number of older adults with multimorbidity and geriatric syndromes such as frailty, falls, malnutrition, cognitive impairment, and polypharmacy. The Geriatric Registry of Würzburg (GRoW) aims to improve the understanding and care of hospitalized older adults by collecting real-world clinical data during routine care.

The registry will include geriatric patients (aged ≥70 years with geriatric multimorbidity or all patients aged ≥80 years). Clinical information, standardized geriatric assessments, laboratory findings, and treatment data routinely collected during hospitalization will be documented. Data will be collected at several time points to evaluate disease trajectories, treatment effects, and long-term outcomes.

The registry focuses on the prevalence of geriatric syndromes, reasons for hospital admission, the effects of specialized geriatric care, medication safety, rehabilitation, and other factors influencing health, functional status, and independence in older adults. The findings are intended to support evidence-based, personalized geriatric care and improve quality of life, functional independence, and healthcare outcomes in this growing patient population.
conditions: Collection of routine clinical data from geriatric patients

interventions.name: Registry.  Observation period up to 30 years.
